variants.label: Flex Repeater
variants.tooltip: Creates multiple instances of views for display in another view.

variants.label: Row
variants.tooltip: Creates multiple instances of views for display in another view.

variants.label: Column
variants.tooltip: Creates multiple instances of views for display in another view.

path.description: Path of the view to display

instances.description: List of params for each rendered view. Each instance will contain an instanceStyle and instancePosition property. Changing these properties will override the styling and positioning applied by elementStyle and elementPosition.

direction.description: Direction of layout of repeated views.

wrap.description: Whether the container should allow repeated views to wrap to next line if space has run out.

justify.description: Adjusts placement of repeated views along the main axis when there is extra space, which may be used to fill areas before, after or in-between.

alignItems.description: Adjusts placement of repeated views along the cross axis when there is extra space.

alignContent.description: Adjusts alignment of repeated views when there is free space in the cross axis.

useDefaultViewWidth.description: Use of view's default width instead of adjusting based on the content's width. This will override all flex position properties in the row and row-reverse direction.

useDefaultViewHeight.description: Use of view's default height instead of adjusting based on the content's height. This will override all flex position properties in the column and column-reverse direction.

elementStyle.description: Style properties that are applied to all repeated views.

elementPosition.description: Flex position properties that are applied to all repeated views.

order.description: Controls when the embedded views load: after the parent is displayed or combined with the parent view loading
